description: You are in a kitchen. An usual one. Okay, just remember what you're here to do, and everything will go great. You see an opened fridge in the corner. The fridge contains an orange bell pepper. You check the price tag glued to the fridge. Three hundred big ones?! That's ridiculous! I have a person who works for the mayor who could get you one of those for 75 bucks! You can see an oven. What a letdown! The oven is empty! Oh wow! Is that what I think it is? It is! It's a table. Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it. Were you looking for a counter? Because look over there, it's a counter. What a coincidence, weren't you just thinking about a counter? On the counter you make out a cookbook and a knife. You make out a stove. The stove is conventional. But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of junk. Hm. Oh well
thought: Need recipe first to know required ingredients/steps; cookbook is on counter, so examine it next.
